description: A white rectangular base with two circular recesses sits on a green tablecloth, with one upright white block already attached on the right side and a separate matching block nearby. The left hand picks up the loose block, moves it rightward over the base, lowers it into the left-side recess, and adjusts it upright, while the right hand stays resting on the base to steady it; the block is a left-hand object and the base is a right-hand object.
